title: Kulgam terror attack: Chilling CCTV video captures CRPF jawans dodging bullets

Three jawans were injured, one critically, and taken to an Anantnag hospital. The attackers fled, prompting a massive security operation, with agencies examining CCTV footage to trace their route.

Additionally, Democrats may push for reforms in the H-1B visa program, which significantly impacts Indian professionals. The future political landscape suggests ongoing debates around immigration policy and potential legislative initiatives.

description: A US immigration proposal could impose significant fees on universities recommending international students for Optional Practical Training. The proposed fees may limit access to practical training for financial reasons. Educational institutions worry this could drive away international students and harm US competitiveness. International students contribute billions annually to the economy and support many jobs in the country. The coalition argues this rule could disrupt university research and employer partnerships.

title: Mumbai to get 5 more air monitoring stations, all inside gardens
description: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation plans to set up five additional air quality monitoring stations across Mumbai. The total investment for these new stations will be Rs 17.50 crore, with planned hourly monitoring. Locations include parks and recreational grounds in various neighborhoods not currently monitored by other networks. Data from the new stations will be available on the BMC portal linked to the Central Pollution Control Board server.

title: Move abroad or quit by December: IBM ends visa sponsorship for most consultants
description: IBM is ending US visa and Green card sponsorship for most roles in IBM Consulting, its largest division with over 150,000 employees. Affected visa holders can work for IBM outside the US or leave by year-end, Bloomberg reported. The move follows the Trump administration's H-1B visa crackdown, which includes a $100,000 fee and last month's suspension of Microsoft, Infosys and TCS from the PERM green card process.

title: Possessive partner, adoption twist: What cops found in Kolkata techie murder case
description: Sanchalika Basu has been arrested for allegedly murdering her live-in partner Sarthak Sarkar during an argument. Their relationship had experienced strain due to Sanchalika's possessiveness over Sarthak's social media interactions. Police investigations revealed that Sanchalika's mother, Moumita, is also under scrutiny for her potential involvement. Neighbors reported hearing loud arguments shortly before the incident occurred. The authorities are awaiting the post-mortem results to establish further details regarding the case.

description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are excitedly awaiting the arrival of their fourth child, expanding their family further. The couple, who share three previous children, skillfully balances parenting with Patrick's demanding NFL career. Their love story blossomed in 2021, culminating in their marriage in 2022 and the joyous births of their children, each cherishing unique bonds with Patrick's football journey.
